tei:div.tei:p: blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa las rang rgyud ngan pa dma' dbab pa'i chos bzhugs so/ /rang 'dod 'khri ba ma zhugs pas/ /theg dman lta bar mi ltung zhing / /srid pa'i btson rar ma bsdams pa'i/ /grol ba de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nga'o bya ba mgo bskor yin/ /dgos zhes bya ba ngo dga' yin/ /gzhan ma zhes pa dgra tshig yin/ /mi dgos ces pa bar chad yin/ /bdag gzhan ces pa 'byed tshig yin/ /chags sdang zhes pa 'khrug pa yin/ /'di 'dra'i rnam dbye su byed pa/ /de ni zab mo'i chos las nyams/ /mkhas pas dgra bo 'joms 'dod na/ /dang po nga bdag khyad du bsad/ /gang gis skur ba btab gyur kyang / /de la ngag 'tshang rnams mi byed/ /gang gis gnod pa bskyal gyur kyang / /kha 'dzin shags 'debs yang mi byed/ /lus srog longs spyod bral gyur kyang / /rang gi bsags pas lan no zhes/ /lhag par rang la snying tshim bgrang / /gang gis 'dre gdon rbad gyur kyang / /de la khu 'khrigs mi bya ste/ /gzhan gyi bsam pa tshim par bya/ /mi phod bsam pa rdzi ba ste/ /snying dang 'dra ba'i 'khor la sogs/ /sha la brtse bas phrogs gyur kyang / /rang la 'gal med snying tshim bgrang / /yon bdag drin lan log mjal tshe/ /skad cig tsam yang mi 'khrugs par/ /bzod bskul bka' drin dran par bya/ /da ni sdig pa spong ba'i thabs/ /zhe sdang med par dbye bar bshad/ /de la bka' drin byams pa bsgom/ /rang la snying tshim tho les btab/ /de ltar bzod pa ma thob bar/ /grogs ni gshis ngan dag dang 'grogs/ /de la dmigs rkyen rab byas nas/ /'khor ba pa yi skyon bsam zhing / /snying rje chen po lhag par bsgom/ /gnas mal sa phug gad skyibs dang / /khang rul thigs pa 'dzags pa dang / /lha khang phyugs lhas 'brog stong dang / /gcong rong yid mi dga' bar bsdad/ /de tshe shes pa mi dga' zhing / /klung du bsdad na ri la 'gro/ /der ni sdod snying mi 'dod de/ /gso dang skyibs dang zur la snyeg

/yang yang sdod sa rab spo zhing / /shes pa mi dga' skyo ba na/ /rang la shags 'debs 'di ltar bya/ /khyod kyi shes spyod 'di 'dra na/ /gnas mal 'di yang yang rab yin/ /blo sems 'di kun bde mo yin/ /gzhan du khyod kyi sdug sran 'dis/ /dmyal bar ma skyes mkhar rje che/ /btso bsregs ma myong mkhar rje che/ /yi dwags bkres skom grong khyer du/ /bskal bar ma skyes mkhar rje che/ /mi gtsang srin po'i grong khyer du/ /'dam rdzab chen por rab 'phyo zhing / /bskal bar ma skyes mkhar rje che/ /gzhan yang 'jigs pa rab bsams shing / /bdag la khrel brdas chos so bya/ /lto la gyong skur dka' thub bya/ /gos la gyong skur dman cha bzung / /bde skyid khyad bsad gnyen po bsgom/ /bya byed lings bskyur byar med bsten/ /ci byed byang chub grogs su bsgyur/ /blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa las rang rgyud ngan pa dma' dbab pa'i chos yongs su rdzogs so// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa las rang rgyud ngan pa dma' dbab pa'i chos/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
